interest: Indexes US surveillance of Japanese tuna fishing, mining, and cotton ventures in Costa Rica as possible fronts threatening Panama Canal.
overview: Docket (Form DS-45) for 894.20218, 1932-40, on Japanese activity in Costa Rica: Puntarenas fishing negotiations by the Japan Union Fishery Company and Yoshitaro Amano, a bid for the Pacific Refrigeration Company, Gulf of Dulce interest, press propaganda, and espionage allegations against T. Wakabayashi; most records cross-referenced elsewhere.

subfiles.about: Department of State docket list of papers and cross-reference index recording intelligence and diplomatic reports on Japanese military, naval, espionage, and commercial activities in Costa Rica from 1932 to 1940.
subfiles.summary: Four-page docket (Form DS-45) for 894.20218 indexing 1932-40 records on Japanese activity in Costa Rica: Puntarenas fishing talks involving Yoshitaro Amano, a bid for the Pacific Refrigeration Company, Gulf of Dulce interest, espionage claims against T. Wakabayashi, and press propaganda; most underlying records filed under 818.628 and 718.94.
